items.title: 6.8 Hess's law of heat summation (Hess ka heat jama karne ka law) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.8, printed pages 126-130, with the sample problems worked and Quick Checks 6.4 to 6.6 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Thermodynamics ka first law asal mein law of conservation of energy (energy ke baqi rehne ka law) ki hi ek shakal hai, jo kehta hai:

blocks.title: Law of conservation of energy
blocks.text: Energy na paida ki ja sakti hai na khatam ki ja sakti hai, lekin ek shakal se doosri shakal mein badli ja sakti hai.

Germain Henri Hess ne yeh law enthalpy changes par lagaya. Bohat se reactions aise hain jin ka ΔH calorimeter se seedha nahi napa ja sakta. Misal: tetrachloromethane (CCl₄) carbon aur chlorine ko seedha mila kar nahi banaya ja sakta. Aise reactions ki enthalpy change Hess’s law se nikalti hai. Yeh law kehta hai:

blocks.title: Hess’s Law
blocks.text: Kisi chemical reaction ki total enthalpy change is baat par depend nahi karti ke reaction kis route (raste) se hua, jab tak initial aur final conditions (shuru aur aakhir ki halat) ek jaisi hon.

Hess’s law ko enthalpy cycles se samjhaya jata hai, jinhen energy cycles ya Hess cycles bhi kehte hain. Farz karein A ek hi step mein seedha B ban jata hai; yeh direct route hai. Ya A do ya teen steps mein B banta hai; yeh indirect route 1 aur indirect route 2 hain (Figure 6.4). In raston mein banne wali cheezen (M, N aur X, Y, Z) reaction intermediates (beech mein banne wali cheezen) kehlati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is paragraph mein 'Figure 6.8' likhti hai, lekin yeh cycle Figure 6.4 (Hess’ cycle) hai jo isi paragraph ke saath chhapi hai. Figure 6.8 sodium chloride ka enthalpy cycle hai.

blocks.alt: Hess ka cycle. Baen laal box A aur daen laal box B ek mota laal arrow delta Hr (direct route) se jure hain. Oopar hare arrow A se hare box M + N (delta H1) aur phir B (delta H2) tak jate hain: indirect route 1. Neeche neele arrow A se X (delta H3), X se Y + Z (delta H4) aur Y + Z se B (delta H5) tak: indirect route 2. Dashed arrow teeno raste dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Hess ka cycle (kitab ki Figure 6.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: A se B tak teen raste hain: seedha laal arrow (ΔHr), oopar wala rasta M + N se (ΔH₁ phir ΔH₂), aur neeche wala rasta X aur Y + Z se (ΔH₃, ΔH₄, ΔH₅). Hess’ law kehta hai ke kisi bhi raste ke steps ka jama ΔHr ke barabar hai.
Is liye Hess’ law ke mutabiq:

blocks.latex: \text{For the indirect route 1: }\ \Delta H_r = \Delta H_1 + \Delta H_2
blocks.text_alt: For the indirect route 1, we can write: ΔHr = ΔH₁ + ΔH₂

blocks.latex: \text{For the indirect route 2: }\ \Delta H_r = \Delta H_3 + \Delta H_4 + \Delta H_5
blocks.text_alt: For the indirect route 2, we can write: ΔHr = ΔH₃ + ΔH₄ + ΔH₅

blocks.text: Neeche is ki kuch misalen hain.
i) Calculating Enthalpy of Formation (ΔH°f) using Enthalpy of Combustion (ΔH°c) (combustion se formation nikalna)

blocks.title: Sample problem 6.3
blocks.problem:
Neeche diye gaye combustion data aur Hess cycle se CO ki enthalpy change of formation nikalein.
C(graphite) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g)    ΔH = –393.5 kJ mol⁻¹
CO(g) + ½ O₂(g) → CO₂(g)    ΔH₂ = –283 kJ mol⁻¹
C(graphite) + ½ O₂(g) → CO(g)    ΔH₁ = ?
steps: Carbon se CO₂ do raston se ban sakti hai: seedha (ΔH), ya pehle CO (ΔH₁) aur phir CO se CO₂ (ΔH₂).
Hess’ law: ΔH = ΔH₁ + ΔH₂, is liye ΔH₁ = ΔH – ΔH₂
blocks.answer: ΔH₁ = –110.5 kJ mol⁻¹ (CO ki enthalpy of formation)

blocks.alt: CO ki formation ka Hess cycle: C + O2 seedha CO2 banata hai (delta H); doosra rasta C + O2 se CO + 1/2 O2 (delta H1) aur phir CO2 (delta H2) tak jata hai. Oopar aur neeche neele curved arrow do raste dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Sample Problem 6.3 ka Hess cycle (kitab ke page 127 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke is cycle mein neeche wale box par ghalti se 'C + O₂' chhapa hai. Asal mein intermediate (beech wali cheez) CO + ½O₂ hai: pehle carbon CO banata hai (ΔH₁), phir CO jal kar CO₂ banti hai (ΔH₂). Is liye ΔH = ΔH₁ + ΔH₂.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sample problem 6.3 ki chhapi hui cycle mein intermediate 'C + O₂' likhi hai; sahi CO + ½O₂ hai, jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.
ii) Calculating Enthalpy Change of Reaction (ΔH°r) using Enthalpies of formation (ΔH°f) (formation data se reaction ki ΔH)

blocks.title: Sample Problem 6.4
blocks.problem:
Hess cycle aur neeche diye gaye formation data se is reaction ki enthalpy change nikalein:
C₂H₄ + HCl → C₂H₅Cl
ΔH°f (C₂H₄) = +52.2 kJ mol⁻¹
ΔH°f (HCl) = –92.3 kJ mol⁻¹
ΔH°f (C₂H₅Cl) = –109 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab sawal mein 'following combustion data' likhti hai, lekin diye gaye numbers enthalpies of formation (ΔH°f) hain. Kitab 'KJ' bhi likhti hai; sahi unit kJ hai.

blocks.alt: Hess cycle: C2H4(g) + HCl(g) se C2H5Cl(g) (delta H). Neeche neele box mein elements 2C(s) + 2 1/2 H2(g) + 1/2 Cl2(g); is se arrow oopar C2H4 (+52.2), HCl (-92.3) aur C2H5Cl (-109) tak jate hain. Neeli dotted lines box se C2H5Cl tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Sample Problem 6.4 ka Hess cycle (kitab ke page 127 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche elements hain: 2C(s) + 2½H₂(g) + ½Cl₂(g). Har arrow us cheez ki enthalpy of formation hai jis tak woh jata hai (+52.2, –92.3, –109). Elements se C₂H₅Cl tak do raste hain, is liye +52.2 + (–92.3) + ΔH = –109. Kitab mein 2C(s) aur 2½H₂(g) ke beech '+' chhoot gaya hai aur Cl ko 'CI' chhapa hai; yahan sahi likha hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sample Problem 6.4 ki chhapi hui cycle mein 2C(s) aur 2½H₂(g) ke beech '+' nahi hai aur 'Cl' ki jagah 'CI' chhapa hai.
Quick Check 6.4

blocks.prompt: Combustion enthalpies C(s) –394, H₂(g) –286 aur C₆H₆(l) –3267 kJ mol⁻¹ se 6C(s) + 3H₂(g) → C₆H₆(l) ki standard enthalpy of formation nikalein.
blocks.explanation: ΔH°f = [6 × (–394) + 3 × (–286)] – (–3267) = –2364 – 858 + 3267 = +45 kJ mol⁻¹. Yani benzene ka banna endothermic hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab sawal mein 'formation of methane' likhti hai, lekin equation 6C(s) + 3H₂(g) → C₆H₆(l) benzene (C₆H₆) ke banne ki hai; sawal benzene ki enthalpy of formation ka hai.
iv) Calculating Enthalpy Change of Formation of a substance (ΔHf°) using Enthalpy of Combustion and Enthalpies of Formation of other substances (doosri cheezon ke data se ΔH°f)

blocks.title: Sample problem 6.6
blocks.problem:
Propane (C₃H₈) oxygen mein is equation ke mutabiq jalti hai:
C₃H₈(g) + 5 O₂(g) → 3 CO₂(g) + 4 H₂O(g)
Jab 14.64 g propane ko 25 °C aur 1 atm par calorimeter mein zyada oxygen mein jalaya gaya to 678.6 kJ heat nikli. Propane ki standard enthalpy of formation nikalein. CO₂(g) aur H₂O(g) ki standard enthalpies of formation –393.51 aur –241.82 kJ mol⁻¹ hain.
steps: Pehle ek mole propane jalne ki enthalpy change nikalein.
Moles = 14.64 ÷ 44.096 = 0.3320 mol; yeh 678.6 kJ heat dete hain.
1 mol propane: 678.6 ÷ 0.3320 = 2044 kJ nikli, yani ΔHc = –2044 kJ mol⁻¹
Hess’ law: ΔHr = [3 × ΔH°f (CO₂) + 4 × ΔH°f (H₂O)] – [1 × ΔH°f (C₃H₈) + 5 × ΔH°f (O₂)]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Hess wali line mein reactants ke liye 'ΔH°c (C₃H₈)' aur 'ΔH°c (O₂)' likhti hai aur kehti hai 'heat of combustion of O₂ zero hai'. Sahi: yahan dono jagah enthalpy of formation (ΔH°f) hai, aur element O₂ ki ΔH°f zero hai. Jawab –104 kJ mol⁻¹ sahi hai.
Quick Check 6.5

blocks.prompt: Sample problem 6.6 ki enthalpy cycle Hess’ law ke mutabiq banayein taa ke calculation ki validation (tasdeeq) ho.
blocks.explanation: Neeche elements likhein: 3C(graphite) + 4H₂(g) + 5O₂(g). Oopar bayen C₃H₈(g) + 5O₂(g) aur daen 3CO₂(g) + 4H₂O(g). Elements se C₃H₈ tak arrow ΔH°f(C₃H₈) = ?; elements se products tak arrow 3(–393.51) + 4(–241.82) = –2147.81 kJ; C₃H₈ + 5O₂ se products tak arrow ΔHc = –2044 kJ. Do raste barabar: ΔH°f(C₃H₈) + (–2044) = –2147.81, is liye ΔH°f(C₃H₈) = –104 kJ mol⁻¹.

answer_figure.alt: Propane ki Hess cycle: neeche elements 3C(graphite) + 4H₂(g) + 5O₂(g). Oopar baen C₃H₈(g) + 5O₂(g), oopar daen 3CO₂(g) + 4H₂O(g). Hara arrow elements se propane tak ΔH°f(C₃H₈) = ?; laal arrow propane se products tak ΔH°c = −2044 kJ; neela arrow elements se products tak 3(−393.51) + 4(−241.82) = −2147.81 kJ. Neeche result: ΔH°f(C₃H₈) = −104 kJ mol⁻¹.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: sample problem 6.6 (propane) ki Hess' law enthalpy cycle
answer_figure.long_description: Teen boxes: neeche elements 3C(graphite) + 4H₂(g) + 5O₂(g); oopar baen C₃H₈(g) + 5O₂(g); oopar daen 3CO₂(g) + 4H₂O(g). Raasta 1 (hara + laal): elements se pehle propane banta hai (ΔH°f = ?), phir propane jalta hai (ΔH°c = −2044 kJ). Raasta 2 (neela): elements seedhe products bante hain, 3(−393.51) + 4(−241.82) = −2147.81 kJ. Hess' law ke mutabiq dono raston ki enthalpy barabar hai: ΔH°f + (−2044) = −2147.81, is liye ΔH°f(C₃H₈) = −104 kJ mol⁻¹, jo kitab ke hisab se milta hai.

blocks.text: v) Calculating Enthalpy Change of Reactions (ΔHr) using Bond Energies (bond energies se ΔHr)

Hess’ law ka ek special case yeh hai ke gas phase reactions ki heat of reaction ka andaza bond energies se lagaya jaye. Pehle step mein sab reactant molecules ke bonds tor kar gas phase mein free (azad) atoms bana diye jate hain; is step ki enthalpy change Table 6.1 ki bond energies jama kar ke milti hai. Doosre step mein in atoms se product molecules bante hain; is step ki enthalpy change bhi Table 6.1 se milti hai, magar negative sign ke saath, kyun ke ab bonds toot nahi rahe balke ban rahe hain. Aam taur par kisi bhi gaseous reaction ki heat of reaction average bond energies se Hess’ law ki is shakal se nikalti hai:

blocks.alt: Triangle: 'Reactants' se 'Products' tak arrow, laal label delta H(o)rxn; 'Reactants' se neeche 'Atoms' tak arrow E(R); 'Atoms' se oopar 'Products' tak arrow E(P).
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Hess cycle; bond energies aur delta Hr = sum n ER - sum n EP ka relationship (kitab ki doosri Figure 6.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: ER = reactants ke tootne wale bonds ki energies ka jama (energy andar), EP = products ke banne wale bonds ki energies ka jama (energy bahar). n har bond ki ginti hai. ΔH = ER – EP.

blocks.title: Sample problem 6.7
blocks.problem:
H₂(g) aur Cl₂(g) se HCl(g) banne ke liye Table 6.1 ki bond energies se ΔH ka andaza lagayein:
H₂(g) + Cl₂(g) → 2 HCl(g)
Aakhir mein HCl ki heat of formation nikalein.
steps: Is reaction ko do hypothetical (farzi) steps mein todte hain: pehle reactants ke saare bonds tootte hain, phir atoms jud kar products banate hain.
First step: H₂(g) + Cl₂(g) → 2H(g) + 2Cl(g); EH–H = 436, ECl–Cl = 242 kJ mol⁻¹
ER = (1 mol × 436 kJ/mol) + (1 mol × 242 kJ/mol) = 436 + 242 = 678 kJ
ΔHr° = ∑ER – ∑EP = 678 – 862 = –184 kJ (2 mol HCl ke liye)
blocks.answer: HCl ki enthalpy of formation = –184 ÷ 2 = –92 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.alt: Sample Problem 6.7 ka Hess triangle. Baen H2(g) + Cl2(g), daen 2HCl(g), dono seedhe arrow se jure hain jis par delta Hr degree likha hai (direct route). Neeche ek muRa arrow H2(g) + Cl2(g) se 2H(g) + 2Cl(g) tak jata hai, aur doosra muRa arrow 2H(g) + 2Cl(g) se oopar 2HCl(g) tak (atoms wala rasta).
blocks.caption: H₂(g) + Cl₂(g) → 2HCl(g) ka Hess triangle: seedha rasta (ΔHr°) aur atoms 2H(g) + 2Cl(g) wala rasta (kitab mein ΔHr° wali lines ke saath, caption ke baghair).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wala seedha arrow poora reaction hai (ΔHr°). Neeche wala rasta do steps hain: pehle H–H aur Cl–Cl bonds toot kar atoms bante hain (ER = 678 kJ andar jati hai), phir atoms jud kar 2HCl bante hain (EP = 862 kJ bahar nikalti hai). Hess’ law ke mutabiq dono raston ki ΔH barabar hai: 678 – 862 = –184 kJ.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein '436 kJ + 242 kJ = 478 kJ' chhapa hai; sahi jama 678 kJ hai. Kitab aage hisab mein 678 hi istemal karti hai, is liye –184 kJ aur –92 kJ mol⁻¹ sahi hain.
Energy cycle neeche di gai hai:

blocks.alt: Energy-level diagram. Sab se oopar: 2 H & 2 Cl atoms (do neele aur do laal balls). Baen beech wala level: H2 & Cl2 molecules (neela H-H aur laal Cl-Cl). Daen sab se neecha level: 2 HCl molecules. Laal-grey arrow beech se oopar: delta HR = +678 kJ. Oopar se sab se neeche tak grey arrow: delta HP = -862 kJ. Beech se neeche mota kala arrow: delta Hrxn = -184 kJ.
blocks.caption: Hess ka cycle; H2 + Cl2 se 2HCl ke liye bond energies aur delta H ka relationship (kitab ke page 129 par Sample Problem 6.7 ke saath chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche H₂ aur Cl₂ molecules hain. Bonds torne ke liye 678 kJ chahiye (teer oopar, atoms ki level tak). Atoms se 2 HCl bante waqt 862 kJ nikalte hain (lamba arrow neeche). Neeche jane wala arrow zyada lamba hai, is liye total ΔH = –184 kJ.
Quick Check 6.6

blocks.prompt: a) Haber process N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) ki enthalpy change nikalein: EN≡N = 945, EH–H = 436, EN–H = 391 kJ mol⁻¹.
blocks.explanation: Toote: 1 N≡N + 3 H–H = 945 + 3 × 436 = 2253 kJ. Bane: 2NH₃ mein 6 N–H = 6 × 391 = 2346 kJ. ΔH = 2253 – 2346 = –93 kJ (2 mol NH₃ ke liye).

blocks.prompt: b) C₂H₅OH(l) + 3O₂(g) → 2CO₂(g) + 3H₂O(l) ki enthalpy change nikalein: EC–C 347, EC–H 410, EC–O 336, EO=O 496, EC=O 805, EO–H 465 kJ mol⁻¹.
blocks.explanation: Toote: ethanol mein 1 C–C (347) + 5 C–H (2050) + 1 C–O (336) + 1 O–H (465), aur 3 O=O (1488); total 4686 kJ. Bane: 2CO₂ mein 4 C=O (3220) aur 3H₂O mein 6 O–H (2790); total 6010 kJ. ΔH = 4686 – 6010 = –1324 kJ mol⁻¹ (bond energies gas ke liye hain, is liye yeh sirf andaza hai).

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Hess’ law: total enthalpy change raste par depend nahi karti, sirf initial aur final conditions par; kisi bhi raste ke steps ka jama ΔHr hai.
Istemal: combustion data se formation (CO: –110.5), formation data se reaction (C₂H₅Cl: –68.9), napi hui heat se formation (propane: –104), bond energies se reaction (HCl: –92 kJ mol⁻¹).
Bond energies se: ΔH = ∑n ER – ∑n EP.
